reason: Striveworks is the success case Barry Hess sells against, not a prospect: ~66-77 employees (PitchBook: 77; LinkedIn: 66) versus his stated 8-30 ICP, $50.3M raised with a Mar 2026 Washington Harbour growth round, and an April 2026 $70M Pentagon-wide enterprise agreement (W56KGU-26-D-A001) putting Chariot in front of up to 950,000 defense personnel. Its live postings are fielding-capacity hires, not confessions of missing cleared leadership - the DevOps roles are already embedded on-site at Fort Carson and Joint Base Lewis-McChord ('you are the tactical edge of our engineering team'), the company is already deployed across Army NGC2, EUCOM, INDOPACOM and CENTCOM, and was named in the 2020 NSCAI final report as the model to follow for operational AI/ML. They crossed the valley of death years ago; nearly every req requires an existing Active Secret or TS/SCI clearance, which means cleared staffing and cleared program leadership are already in place. No live line redescribes lab-to-field stall or absent senior technical advocacy.
